text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as Aston Machan was
walking all by herself—

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text:
Um, you're Aston Machan, right?!
We're huge fans! We're so thrilled to meet you~!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, really?
Ehehe, thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So everyone, how about taking some photos?
Or is there anything else you'd like to do?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please, go right ahead and savor Machan to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Are you sure!?
God-tier fan service! P-Please, by all means...!

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
Drinking Hachimi together was my dream~!
It'll be a memory I'll cherish forever!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What does everyone want to do next?
Machan is ready to hang out with you all day!

text_block_list.name: Female Fans
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but I'd feel terrible taking up any more of your time!
You must have training and all...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Training can be done anytime, but I don't know if I'll always have time to spend with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let's make memories with Chan that will last a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Aston Machan ended up
skipping her training session.
